title: Florida Teen's Sickening Crime Exposed by DNA
description:
A 91-year-old Florida woman was attacked in the middle of the night by what she could only identify as a "dark shadow" figure. She called the police immediately after the attacker left her home. With a trove of evidence, investigators were able to pinpoint the perpetrator — her 14-year-old neighbor Jesse Stone. Find out what happened to Jesse Stone on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.
